description: A hybrid model featuring an Embedding layer, followed by a Conv1D for local feature extraction. The Conv1D output is then processed by a Bidirectional GRU to capture sequential dependencies. A MultiHeadAttention layer performs self-attention on the GRU's output, allowing the model to weigh different parts of the sequence. A residual connection and LayerNormalization are applied after attention. Finally, GlobalAveragePooling1D is used before a Dense classifier layer.
